what: TMS320C5x on-chip ROM read from the DSP of the 25 MHz Courier 2806, plus three windows above it
board: 25 MHz Courier V.Everything 2806, serial 22AEB36ACKND, reflashed to ID_SDL v4.03d on 2026-09-13 (artifacts/xmodem-program-id25-403); supervisor 7.4.16, DSP 3.1.2
method: same as artifacts/dsp-onchip-rom-01 - probe_transport --rom-dump delivered to supervisor RAM at 0x3000 with ATGLK2W, armed through timer 0, read with RPT/TBLR from a kernel at program 0x8000, returned through the DSP mailbox. run-board.py in this directory is the runner.

0x0800-0x0BFF.result: two runs byte-identical; two distinct values, a 32-word period of 16 x FFFF then 16 x 0000

0x1C00-0x1FFF.result: the same 32-word square wave except 0x1F90-0x1FFF, which holds 112 words of kernel-shaped code - unexplained, see README

caveats: MP/MC was still not read directly.
The 0x0800 stability test does not discriminate 'C50 from 'C51 the way docs/probing.md predicted. See README.md.
